domain.description: The Spider (Yu et al., 2018) database employee_hire_evaluation, with tables employee, shop, hiring and evaluation.
domain.source_note: Spider (Yu et al., 2018) benchmark database employee_hire_evaluation, used as-is -- schema and data are third-party, not authored for this project.
